tagline.en: eSIM store from the WiFi-app maker; pay-as-you-go data that never expires
tagline.zh: WiFi 应用出品的 eSIM 商店，支持不过期按量付费

description.en: Instabridge started as a crowdsourced WiFi-hotspot app (200M+ downloads) and now sells travel eSIMs for 190+ countries, including pay-as-you-go data where unused balance does not expire.
description.zh: Instabridge 以众包 WiFi 热点应用起家（200M+ 下载），现销售 190+ 国家和地区的旅行 eSIM，含不过期的按量付费数据。

validity.en: Fixed packs dated; PAYG balance does not expire
validity.zh: 定额包按期；按量余额不过期

en: From a widely used consumer app
zh: 出自亿级用户的消费应用

details.en:
Instabridge began as a crowdsourced WiFi-hotspot app (200M+ downloads per its own claims) and later layered an eSIM store on top, now covering 190+ countries and regions. Its structural difference is pay-as-you-go data whose balance does not expire: third-party directories quote never-expiring PAYG plus a ~$16/30-day 10GB Europe pack - both are third-party figures; the official store renders client-side and its price list could not be captured on 2026-11-10, so treat the in-app checkout as the source of truth.

Who it fits: light users with irregular trips who hate expiring data; onboarding needs no eKYC.

Risks and notes: third-party reviews are mixed (one comparison directory scores it 3.0); as an eSIM seller it is less specialized than travel-eSIM natives, with thinner plan depth and support; per-destination networks are not disclosed. Start with a small top-up.
details.zh:
Instabridge 起家于众包 WiFi 热点应用（官方口径 200M+ 下载），后来在应用内叠加了 eSIM 商店，现覆盖 190+ 国家和地区。它的结构性差异是"按量付费余额不过期"：第三方目录口径称其 PAYG 余额永不过期，另有约 $16/30 天的欧洲 10GB 定额包——这两条均为第三方口径，官网商店为客户端渲染，2026-11-10 未能直抓价目，以 App 内结算页为准。

适合人群：用量轻、行程不定期、讨厌"流量到期作废"的用户；开通免 eKYC。

风险与注意：第三方评价两极（某对比目录仅 3.0 分）；作为 eSIM 卖家其专注度低于专业旅行品牌，套餐深度与客服面较薄；官网未披露逐目的地落地网络。建议首次小额试用。

如需长期持有，其按量余额不过期的特性比定额日包更适合保存"应急流量"；但正因商店为 JS 渲染、价格与套餐变动无法在网页层留痕，建议购买前截图结算页留证。
